title: GOAL: Planner may commit; rollback record for every change
spec: User decision 2026-09-17: the Planner may git commit/add/branch/push (it still never edits source); every change must be documented so it can be rolled back; the Planner does the work instead of handing the human commands. Blocked git ops stay: merge, rebase, cherry-pick, apply, am, reset --hard (the merge queue and workers own history rewriting). Container task for T-execute child. Complexity 2; no scouts (the Planner authored planner-mode.sh an hour ago and the exact diff is known; see plan.md).
acceptance: child execute task merged into branch planner-mode with tests green
PR 2 updated and describes the rollback path
decisions.md has a dated entry with the revert path
